evals.expected_output: Lists all agent principals with their binding state
expectations: Calls list_agents with the user's auth token
Displays each agent's name, kind, a2a_enabled, owner_only, and binding state (bound device name or unbound)
Does not confuse agents with devices or bots
Checks the API response status field

evals.prompt: Create a new agent called Fable
evals.expected_output: Creates an agent principal named Fable and explains the next steps
expectations: Calls list_agents first to show current state
Calls create_agent with agent_name=Fable (kind defaults to agent, a2a off by default)
Explains that the agent starts owner-only and is not yet bound to a device
Points the user at the doxxGateway repo (github.com/doxxcorp/gateway) to host and bind the agent
Notes the P2P plan + profile name prerequisites if create_agent errors

evals.expected_output: Finds Fable's agent_id, confirms, and deletes it
expectations: Calls list_agents to resolve Fable's agent_id
Warns that deletion revokes all the agent's pairs and its device credential (irreversible chat identity)
Calls delete_agent with the correct agent_id
Notes the device/tunnel remain and can be removed separately with delete_tunnel

evals.prompt: Create a bot for my server
evals.expected_output: Explains bots are deprecated and offers to create an agent instead
expectations: Explains that bot accounts are deprecated (create_bot returns 410) and replaced by agent principals
Offers to create an agent with create_agent instead
Does not attempt create_bot except to demonstrate the deprecation, if at all
